body.p: Correction to: Scientific Reports 10.1038/s41598-024-79772-7, published online 29 November 2024
In the original version of this Article Pritty was incorrectly affiliated with ‘USIC&T, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, New Delhi, 110075, India’. The correct affiliation is listed below.
NIMS Institute of Engineering and Technology (NIET), NIMS University Rajasthan, Jaipur, India, 303121.
The original Article has been corrected.
